# External Data Placeholder

Raw TCULU national raster files are not redistributed in this compact GitHub package.

To rerun `code/14_extract_tculu_shenzhen.py` from raw data, place files named like the following in this directory:

- `china_land_use2000.tif`
- `china_land_use2005.tif`
- `china_land_use2010.tif`
- `china_land_use2015.tif`
- `china_land_use2020.tif`

The repository already includes clipped Shenzhen TCULU outputs under `data/tculu_shenzhen/` for downstream checks.
